data.summary: Reviews appear highly authentic with detailed, specific praise from customers. The lack of any negative reviews is notable but plausible for a small, highly-rated specialist contractor. The BBB A+ rating with no complaints supports the positive image. The low total review volume is the primary factor keeping the fake score from being lower.
fake_signals: All reviews are 5-star, no negative feedback present
Low total review count (12) for a 3-year-old business

positive_evidence: Reviewer mentions owner came back to monitor system after a hard freeze

authentic_signals: Reviews contain specific project details (replacing 20-year-old plumbing, concrete slab, labeling breakers)
Reviews mention varied services (plumbing, electrical, rebar, equipment install)
Reviews show varied writing styles and specific customer names
Multiple reviews mention the owner (Brandon) by name and praise his responsiveness and thoroughness
Some reviews mention specific gestures like deducting cost of previous work
data.discrepancy_explanation: No significant discrepancies. Google shows a perfect 5.0 with 12 reviews, and BBB shows an A+ rating with no complaints. No other platforms have ratings to compare.

reviews.text: Brandon Vicencio did an amazing job with my pool! He laid down a slab of concrete for my pool equipment and also fixed my clogged drains. Fast, professional and reliable!
reviews.author: husain vitar

reviews.text: Absolutely amazing job! Vicencio Pool Plumbing did a fantastic job all the way through the project. From quoting the project to explaining in detail on how to use the equipment! I highly recommend this company to anyone who wants to upgrade their pool equipment. Thank you Brandon!!!
reviews.author: Will Harman

reviews.text: Brandon and his team are great. They are honest, thorough and goes above and beyond to ensure that their customer is happy. We hired Brandon to fix our pool heater and he made sure no stone was unturned. He then repaired our pool lights and a small job turned into a bigger electrical rework that he was happy to fix and work through. Thank you for being thorough and your hard work!
reviews.author: Melissa Bruner

reviews.text:
Thanks to Brandon I was able to fix my pool light and close my house. I get the incorrect light but Brandon immediately take care of getting the correct light for my pool. He understands my sense of urgency I have on getting this taking care.
I explain the situation and also he label all my breakers and anchor my panel box. Now I know who to call on pool related stuff.
reviews.author: Adrian Nunez

reviews.text: Highly recommend these guys. Extremely professional, always showed up on time, and very clean work!
reviews.author: Brandon Clifton

reviews.text: Vicencio Pool & Plumbing is top notch! Brandon is knowledgeable and extremely responsive. Coming through our first hard freeze after finishing the build, Brandon kept watch over our system and communicated to us often to ensure all was good. Thank you Brandon!
reviews.author: Lori West
